verses.text: Te lokan winhaj Saulo yet' heb' ix milancham winhaj Esteban chi'. Haton wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix och ijan heb' anima yak'anoch sya'elal heb' creyente t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix yab'an wal sya'il heb' sik'lab'il. Yuj chi' ix laj saklemb'at heb'. Ix laj b'at heb' t'a yol yik Judea yet' Samaria. Haxonhej heb' schekab' Jesús ix kan t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ix lajwinhej scham winhaj Esteban chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh ayoch spensar t'a Dios ix ik'anb'at sniwanil winh chi', ix b'at smukanem winh heb'. Ix te ok' heb' winh yuj winh.

Haxo winhaj Saulo chi', ix yak' wal chukal winh t'a heb' creyente. Yalnhej b'aj ayek' heb', ix laj och winh t'a yol spat heb'. Ix laj yik'elta heb' winh winak winh yet' heb' ix ix, ix b'at yak'anoch heb' winh t'a preso.
Haxo heb' creyente ix el t'a Jerusalén, ix laj saklemb'at heb'. Masanil b'ajtak ix laj k'och heb' ix laj yalel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il heb'.
Ay jun winh skuch Felipe ix k'och t'a jun chonhab' t'a yol yik Samaria. Ix yalkanel yab'ixal Cristo winh t'a skal heb'.
Haxo heb' anima ayek' ta', ix smaklej wal yab' heb' tas ix yal winh chi'. Ix yilanpax juntzanh milagro heb' ix sb'o winh.

Ha t'a jun chonhab' chi', tzijtum heb' anima ayoch heb' enemigo t'ay, haxo winhaj Felipe chi' ix laj ik'anel heb' t'a heb'. Ix laj el yaw heb' yel t'a heb'. Tzijtum heb' sikb'inakeli yet' heb' max yal sb'eyi, ix laj b'oxikan heb' yuj winh.
Yuj juntzanh chi' ix te tzalaj sk'o'ol heb' anima smasanil t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Palta ay jun winh winak skuch Simón ta'. Ste ak'ej wal musansatil heb' anima winh, yujto te niwan yelk'och winh yalani, ay tas syal yuj winh yalani.
Masanil heb' malaj yelk'ochi yet' heb' niwan yelk'ochi, jun lajan syak'och spensar heb' t'a winh, syalan heb': --Ha winhaj Simón, haton jun Dios skuchan Niwan Spoder, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Syak' wal och spensar heb' t'a winh, yujto pekatax syamnakoch winh yak'an musansatil heb', syalan winh to tzuji yuj.

Haxo winhaj Felipe chi' ix alanel t'a skal heb' tas tz'aj yoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Dios. Ix yalanel yab'ixal Jesucristo winh t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ay heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix, ix ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol tas ix yal winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix scha'an sbautismo heb'.

Icha pax chi' winhaj Simón chi', ix yak'och slolonel Dios winh t'a sk'o'ol. Ix scha'an pax sbautismo winh. Ix lajwinhej chi', junxonhej ix ek' winh yet' winhaj Felipe chi'. Ay juntzanh milagro ix sch'ox winhaj Felipe chi', te niwan yelk'ochi. Yuj chi', ix te sat sk'o'ol winhaj Simón chi' yilani.
Haxo heb' schekab' Jesús ayek' t'a Jerusalén, ayik ix yab'an heb' to ay heb' aj Samaria ix ak'anoch slolonel Dios t'a sk'o'ol, ix schekb'at winhaj Pedro heb' yet' winhaj Juan yil heb'.
Ayik ix k'och heb' winh, ix lesalwi heb' winh yuj heb' creyente aj Samaria chi', yik wach' tz'ak'ji Espíritu Santo t'a heb',
yujto manta junok heb' scha'ani. Anhejanto t'a sb'i Kajal Jesús b'aj ix ak'ji bautizar heb'.
Haxo winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' ix ak'anek' sk'ab' t'a sjolom heb'. Ichato chi' ix scha'ankan Espíritu Santo chi' heb'.
Ix yilan winhaj Simón chi' to ayik ix yak'anek' sk'ab' heb' winh t'a sjolom heb' creyente chi', ix schakan Espíritu Santo heb', yuj chi' ix yaltej tumin winh t'a heb' winh schekab' Jesús chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Hak'ek wopisio heyet'ok yik wach' yalnhej mach ol wak'ek' in k'ab' t'a sjolom, ol schakan Espíritu Santo chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Pedro t'a winh: --Ach satokab'el yet' k'e'en a tumin chi', yujto a jun tas syak' Dios t'a nab'anhej ix a nib'ej a man yet' jab' a tumin tik.
Malaj halan ik ket'ok. Malaj och t'a jun kopisio tik, yujto manh tojolok a pensar t'a yichanh Dios.
Yuj chi' na a b'a yuj jun a chukal tik. k'an t'a Dios, tope ol ach yak' niwank'olal yuj tas wan a na'an tik.
Yujto swila' to anhej chichonk'olal tza na'a, yujto anhej chukal wan ak'an serwil, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalxi winh: --Tze k'an wal t'a Dios Kajal wu'uj, yik manh ol jawok jun ya'elal tzeyal tik t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.

Haxo pax winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi', ix yalel yab'ixal Jesús heb' winh. Ix yalanpaxel slolonel Dios Kajal heb' winh t'a Samaria chi'. Ixlajwi chi', yakb'an wan smeltzajxib'at heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, tzijtum juntzanh yunetak chonhab' t'a yol yik Samaria chi' b'aj ix ek' heb' winh yalkanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il.

Ay jun yángel Dios Kajal ix halan icha tik t'a winhaj Felipe chi': --Ak' lista a b'a. Ixik t'a sur, t'a jun b'e skot t'a Jerusalén, sk'och t'a chonhab' Gaza, xchi. Ha jun b'e chi', haton jun tzek' t'a tzinan lu'um.

Yuj chi', ix yak' lista sb'a winh, ix b'at winh. Haxo t'a yol b'e chi', ix yil-laj sb'a winh yet' jun winh aj Etiopía. Ha jun winh chi' ay yopisio winh yuj ix Candace, ix yajal yaj t'a Etiopía chi'. Sik'um tumin yaj winh t'a ix. Ix xit'ek' winh yak'em sb'a t'a Dios t'a Jerusalén.
Wan spax winh t'a Etiopía chi'. k'ojanem winh t'a yol jun scarruaje. Wan yilan Slolonel Dios winh tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías, haton winh schekab' Dios.
Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix halan t'a winhaj Felipe chi': --Ixik, nitzb'at a b'a t'a stz'ey jun carruaje chi', xchi.

Haxo ix k'och winh t'a stz'ey, ix yab'an winh to wan yawtan Slolonel Dios winh, haton jun tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh: --¿Tzam nachajel u'uj tas wan awtan chi'? xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Tato malaj mach tzin k'ayb'ani, ¿tas ol aj snachajel wu'uj? ¿Max am yal a k'eta t'a yol carruaje tik yik tzach em k'ojan wet'ok? xchi winh t'a winhaj Felipe chi'

Ha Slolonel Dios wan yawtan winh chi', haton jun tz'alan icha tik: Icha junok nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj ol b'at chamok, icha chi' ol aj yik'jib'at jun Schekab' Dios Kajal schami. Icha junok nok' kalnel tz'innhej xchi sjoxchaji, icha pax chi' ol ajok.
Te k'ixwelal ol yutej heb'. Toxonton manh ol sb'o yaj jab'ok heb' t'ay. Malaj junok mach ol alanok tato ay yinhtilal ol kanok, yujto ol miljokchamok, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a winhaj Felipe chi': --Al t'ayin, ¿mach ay yab'ixal jun yalnakkan winh schekab' Dios chi'? ¿Tom a yab'ixal winh yalnakkani, ma to ch'ok junokxo mach yalnakkan yab'ixal winh? xchi winh aj Etiopía chi'.
Haxo winhaj Felipe chi' ix halan t'a winh tas syalelk'och Slolonel Dios chi'. Ix syamanoch winh yalan yab'ixal Jesucristo t'a winh.
Ayik wan sb'at heb' winh t'a yol b'e chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a jun ha ha'. Ix yalan winh aj Etiopía chi' t'a winh: Ina jun ha ha' tik, ¿max am yal in ak'ankan bautizar tiknaik? xchi winh.
Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yalan winh to syamjioch wa'an jun scarruaje winh chi'. Ix em heb' winh schawanhil t'a yol jun ha ha' chi'. Haxo ta' ix ak'jikan bautizar winh.

Ayik ix lajwi sk'exta heb' winh t'a yol ha ha' chi', haxo Yespíritu Dios ix ik'anb'at winhaj Felipe chi'. Yuj chi' majxo iljilaj winh yuj winh aj Etiopía chi', majxo yil-laj winh b'aj ix k'och winh. Palta te tzalajk'olal ix b'atxikan winh aj Etiopía chi' t'a yol b'e chi'.

Haxo winhaj Felipe chi', ha t'a chonhab' Azoto ix k'och winh. Ix lajwinhej chi', ix b'atxi winh. Ix laj ek' yalankanel wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il winh t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', masanto ix k'och winh t'a chonhab' Cesarea.
